features.title: Powerful AI-Driven Analysis for Every Conversation
features.subtitle: Repvix breaks down customer and sales chats into clear insights about behavior, performance, and outcomes — helping teams improve communication and results.

item1.title: Comprehensive Chat Analysis
item1.desc: Automatically analyze entire conversations — from message flow to tone, sentiment, and intent — to understand what truly happened between agent and customer.

item2.title: Behavior & Communication Insights
item2.desc: Measure clarity, empathy, professionalism, and engagement. Identify communication strengths and recurring behavior patterns across your team.

item3.title: Sales & Resolution Outcomes
item3.desc: Reveal how close a conversation is to reaching agreement or resolution. Detect pricing friction, negotiation dynamics, and outcome confidence.

item4.title: Team Performance Overview
item4.desc: Track each employee’s response time, tone balance, satisfaction impact, and improvement trends — all in one structured view.

item5.title: Knowledge Extraction & FAQs
item5.desc: Automatically extract frequent customer questions and generate accurate responses for your internal knowledge base or FAQ section.

item6.title: Structured Reports & Summaries
item6.desc: Export executive-ready reports with clear metrics, summaries, and recommendations. Perfect for managers and client presentations.

item7.title: Multi-Language Support
item7.desc: Arabic, English, Turkish, French, Spanish, and Hindi — all analyzed with consistent accuracy and contextual understanding.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From raw chat exports to deep performance insights — in three simple steps.

step1.title: Upload Conversations
step1.desc: Import your WhatsApp, Telegram, or chat transcripts (TXT/CSV). Repvix automatically cleans and structures your data for analysis.

step2.title: AI-Powered Analysis
step2.desc: Our AI interprets every message — detecting tone, emotion, and intent. It identifies key moments, behavioral signals, and outcomes for each conversation.

step3.title: Get Clear Insights
step3.desc: View structured results with performance metrics, behavioral scores, and improvement recommendations — ready to export or share with your team.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.a1: Repvix currently supports manual chat uploads in CSV or TXT format. Integrations with WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord are planned for upcoming releases — we’re currently in open beta.
faq.q2: Do all plans use the same AI model?
faq.a2: Yes. Every plan uses the same advanced AI engine and rule-based framework to ensure consistent analysis quality across all accounts and languages.
faq.a3: Each conversation is analyzed for clarity, empathy, professionalism, intent, sentiment, and outcome — producing actionable insights, performance scores, and structured recommendations.
faq.q4: Can I export my analysis results?
faq.a4: Yes! Depending on your plan, you can export analyses as PDF, Markdown, or CSV files — or even extract FAQs automatically for internal knowledge bases.
faq.q5: Is my data private and secure?
faq.a5: Yes. Chats uploaded manually are stored securely in our database so you can revisit or delete them anytime. Conversations imported via future integrations will be processed temporarily without permanent storage.
faq.a6: Yes — Repvix analyzes chats in Arabic, English, Turkish, French, Spanish, and Hindi, maintaining consistent accuracy and context understanding in every language.
faq.q7: Can teams collaborate under one account?
faq.a7: Yes. You can invite your team members to your organization, assign roles, and analyze individual or collective performance depending on your subscription plan.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of Repvix. By using the product, you agree to these terms.
terms.useOfService: You agree to use Repvix only for lawful purposes and in accordance with all applicable laws and regulations. You are responsible for any content you upload, including chat transcripts and customer data. Certain features are available under subscription plans. Cancelling a subscription stops future renewals and access to paid limits at the end of the current billing period; amounts already charged are not automatically refunded, and any refund is handled in accordance with the applicable payment provider’s terms.
terms.dataAndPrivacy: We analyze your uploaded conversations to generate insights and reports. You are responsible for ensuring you have the right to share this data. Chat data and analyses that you upload within an organization are treated as part of that organization’s records. Deleting your personal account or membership does not automatically delete organization data; organization owners or admins may delete the organization, which typically results in permanent deletion of related data from our systems, subject to any legal retention requirements. For more details on how we store and process data, please review our Privacy Policy.
terms.changes: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of Repvix after updates means you accept the revised Terms.
terms.contact: If you have any questions about these Terms, you can contact us through the channels listed on our website.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Repvix collects, uses, and protects your data when you use our service.
privacy.dataWeCollect: We may collect account information (such as name, email, and organization details), usage data, and the chat conversations you choose to upload. This may include analysis results and derived technical representations (for example, numerical vectors used for search and analytics), as well as billing-related records such as subscription identifiers, invoices, and payment status. Some metadata may also be collected automatically for security and analytics.
privacy.howWeUseData: We use your data to provide and improve the Repvix service, including generating analyses, insights, and reports, maintaining security, and improving product experience. We may rely on carefully selected service providers to perform certain processing activities on our behalf, subject to contractual and legal safeguards. We do not sell your data.
privacy.dataRetention: Chat data and analyses may be stored so you can revisit them or manage them from your dashboard. If you delete your personal account, we remove your account credentials and memberships, but organization records (including chats and analyses) may continue to be retained under the control of that organization’s administrators. When an organization is deleted by an authorized administrator, we generally delete associated chats, messages, analyses, and billing records, except where we are required to retain certain information for legal or security reasons.
privacy.yourRights: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us if you wish to exercise any of these rights.
privacy.contact: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please reach out through the contact information on our website.
